summary: This 8-K reports the planned leadership succession at Florida Power & Light Company (FPL), a subsidiary of NextEra Energy, Inc. (NEE). CEO Armando Pimentel, Jr. resigned effective May 18, 2026 and was appointed Vice Chairman of NEE. President Scott Bores succeeded him as FPL CEO effective the same day. No financial terms, advisor, or tender offer are involved. The filing contains no acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation event. It is a routine senior executive transition within a corporate group, not abrupt or forced. Watch for future disclosures regarding NEE's leadership strategy.
